# Patients under the water-peak rule {#sec-usable-patients}

```{python}
#| include: false
from cohort_common import *

found = rule_breasts(WATER_MIN, CENTRE_MIN)
both = sorted({n for n, _ in found if (n, "LEFT") in found and (n, "RIGHT") in found})

# every scan of every usable patient, for the panel plots
usable_records = defaultdict(list)  # (nova, side): [(label, curve, height, centre, usable)]
for nova, side, label, curve, height, centre in scan_records:
    if nova in both:
        usable_records[nova, side].append((label, curve, height, centre, usable(height, centre, WATER_MIN, CENTRE_MIN)))

def pair_name(nova):
    """'CANCER vs NORMAL' etc., or 'NORMAL vs NORMAL', or 'other'."""
    labels = sorted(found[nova, side][0] for side in ("LEFT", "RIGHT"))
    if labels == ["NORMAL", "NORMAL"]:
        return "NORMAL vs NORMAL"
    for comparison, (base, others) in COMPARISONS.items():
        if labels.count(base) == 1 and set(labels) - {base} <= set(others):
            return comparison
    return "other"

GROUPS = list(COMPARISONS) + ["NORMAL vs NORMAL", "other"]
group_novas = {name: [n for n in both if pair_name(n) == name] for name in GROUPS}
# drop empty groups from the body
GROUPS = [name for name in GROUPS if group_novas[name]]

def plot_group(novas, label):
    """One panel per patient, same layout as @fig-new-patients, no outcome tinting."""
    if not novas:
        return
    columns = 8
    rows_needed = int(np.ceil(len(novas) / columns))
    plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 6
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows_needed, columns, figsize=(10, 1.45 * rows_needed + 0.3),
                             sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, nova in zip(axes.flat, novas):
        counts = []
        for side, colour in (("LEFT", "tab:blue"), ("RIGHT", "tab:orange")):
            records = usable_records.get((nova, side), [])
            n_good = sum(ok for *_, ok in records)
            counts.append(f"{side[0]} {n_good}/{len(records)}")
            for _, curve, _, _, ok in records:
                ax.plot(q, curve, color=colour if ok else "grey", lw=0.8 if ok else 0.6, ls="-" if ok else "--")
        ax.hlines(WATER_MIN, *WATER, color="black", lw=2, zorder=5)
        labs = [found[nova, s][0] for s in ("LEFT", "RIGHT")]
        ratios = [found[nova, s][1] for s in ("LEFT", "RIGHT")]
        ax.set_title(f"Nova {nova}: {' / '.join(labs)}\n{', '.join(counts)}; Water:Fat {ratios[0]:.2f}, {ratios[1]:.2f}",
                     fontsize=5.5)
        ax.set(xlim=(2, 25), ylim=(-0.1, 1.8))
    for ax in axes.flat[len(novas):]:
        ax.axis("off")
    for ax in axes[-1]:
        ax.set_xlabel("q (nm⁻¹)")
    fig.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
    plt.show()
    plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 10

def group_table(novas):
    """Markdown table: patient, labels, usable scans, Water:Fat. No colour coding."""
    lines = ["| Patient | Labels (L / R) | Usable scans, L | Usable scans, R | Water:Fat, L | Water:Fat, R |",
             "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for nova in novas:
        left, right = found[nova, "LEFT"], found[nova, "RIGHT"]
        labels = left[0] if left[0] == right[0] else f"{left[0]} / {right[0]}"
        lines.append(f"| Nova {nova} | {labels} | {left[2]} of {left[3]} | {right[2]} of {right[3]} | "
                     f"{left[1]:.2f} | {right[1]:.2f} |")
    return "\n".join(lines)

# NORMAL/NORMAL with neither breast usable (every scan rejected)
breast_info = defaultdict(lambda: [set(), 0, 0])  # labels, usable count, all count
for nova, side, label, curve, height, centre in scan_records:
    info = breast_info[nova, side]
    info[0].add(label); info[1] += usable(height, centre, WATER_MIN, CENTRE_MIN); info[2] += 1
nn_missed = []
for nova in analysis_novas:
    sides = [breast_info.get((nova, side)) for side in ("LEFT", "RIGHT")]
    if any(s is None or len(s[0]) != 1 for s in sides):
        continue
    if [next(iter(s[0])) for s in sides] == ["NORMAL", "NORMAL"] and sides[0][1] == 0 and sides[1][1] == 0:
        nn_missed.append(nova)

def plot_missed(novas):
    columns = 8
    rows_needed = int(np.ceil(len(novas) / columns))
    plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 6
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows_needed, columns, figsize=(10, 1.45 * rows_needed + 0.3),
                             sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, nova in zip(axes.flat, novas):
        counts = []
        for side, colour in (("LEFT", "tab:blue"), ("RIGHT", "tab:orange")):
            records = [(curve,) for n, s, label, curve, height, centre in scan_records if n == nova and s == side]
            counts.append(f"{side[0]} 0/{len(records)}")
            for (curve,) in records:
                ax.plot(q, curve, color=colour, lw=0.7, ls="--", alpha=0.85)
        ax.hlines(WATER_MIN, *WATER, color="black", lw=2, zorder=5)
        ax.set_title(f"Nova {nova}: NORMAL / NORMAL\n{', '.join(counts)}; no usable scan", fontsize=5.5)
        ax.set(xlim=(2, 25), ylim=(-0.1, 1.8))
    for ax in axes.flat[len(novas):]:
        ax.axis("off")
    for ax in axes[-1]:
        ax.set_xlabel("q (nm⁻¹)")
    fig.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
    plt.show()
    plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 10

def missed_table(novas):
    lines = ["| Patient | Labels (L / R) | Usable scans, L | Usable scans, R |",
             "|---|---|---|---|"]
    for nova in novas:
        left, right = breast_info[nova, "LEFT"], breast_info[nova, "RIGHT"]
        lines.append(f"| Nova {nova} | NORMAL / NORMAL | {left[1]} of {left[2]} | {right[1]} of {right[2]} |")
    return "\n".join(lines)
```

Chapter 1 (@sec-water-rich) is the **top/bottom `{python} PART`%** cut on samples. This appendix is different: it applies the **fixed water-peak
rule** of @sec-the-rule (threshold `{python} f"{WATER_MIN:g}"`) scan by scan, and shows every patient in the analysis set with **both breasts
usable** under that rule.

Plotted the same way as the newest patients (@sec-new-patients): one panel per patient, usable scans coloured (left blue, right orange), rejected
scans grey and dashed, black bar the water-peak threshold. No outcome tinting — every patient in the usable groups already has both breasts
usable. Grouped by the label pair used in the paired comparisons (`{python} len(both)` patients), plus the NORMAL/NORMAL patients that missed the
threshold entirely.

## CANCER vs NORMAL

`{python} len(group_novas["CANCER vs NORMAL"])` patients: the paired comparison under the rule of @sec-the-rule.

```{python}
#| label: fig-usable-cancer-normal
#| fig-cap: "CANCER vs NORMAL patients with both breasts usable. Usable scans coloured (left blue, right orange), rejected scans grey dashed; black bar is the water-peak threshold."
plot_group(group_novas["CANCER vs NORMAL"], "CANCER vs NORMAL")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(group_table(group_novas["CANCER vs NORMAL"]))
```

## NORMAL vs NORMAL that missed the threshold

Patients with two NORMAL breasts and **no usable scan in either breast**: every scan sits below the water-peak threshold. Same panel layout; all
scans are rejected, so they are shown dashed. `{python} len(nn_missed)` patients.

```{python}
#| label: fig-missed-normal-normal
#| fig-cap: "NORMAL vs NORMAL patients with no usable scan in either breast. Every scan is below the water-peak threshold (black bar); left breast blue dashed, right orange dashed."
plot_missed(nn_missed)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(missed_table(nn_missed))
```

## Other usable pairs

`{python} len(group_novas["other"])` patients with both breasts usable whose labels are not one of the pairs above (for example BENIGN/BENIGN, or a
side labelled ATYPICAL or PRE_CANCEROUS).

```{python}
#| label: fig-usable-other
#| fig-cap: "Other patients with both breasts usable. Same layout as @fig-usable-cancer-normal."
```
